brief.description: Folded wool cloth with layered woven edges and restrained blue selvage for the Textile Workshop
brief.purpose: Recognizable wool textile intermediate, readable in inventory and recipes.
brief.silhouette: Three-quarter view of a squat folded bolt, broad ivory top with stepped layered front edge.
brief.bounds: Native generated item sprite; square transparent master downscaled to 32x32 with 28px silhouette extent.
brief.materials: Warm ivory woven wool, restrained indigo-blue selvage; no metal, paper or leather.
brief.interfaces: Existing cloth item, inventory/recipe/held use only.
brief.construction: High-resolution generated sprite master reduced by existing alpha-safe item pipeline; native item/generated extrusion.
brief.invariants: Keep registry, recipes, wool-only sourcing and stack sizes unchanged.
fidelity_targets: Woven cloth, not white wool blocks
Visible sparse woven material clusters across the ivory top at native size; no blank center or fine noisy weave

references.role: Existing high-resolution pixel-art family; textile weave and warm top-left lighting only, not food silhouette.

generations.prompt: Create one isolated Minecraft inventory item artwork, high-resolution detailed pixel art on a genuinely transparent background. A neatly folded thick bolt of woven WOOL CLOTH from a late-1800s textile workshop: warm ivory oatmeal fabric, broad rectangular top, two or three clearly layered folded edges visible along the front, subtle woolen weave, ONE narrow muted indigo-blue woven selvage stripe following one edge. Three-quarter inventory view, top and front/right edge visible, squat compact silhouette, slightly uneven soft folded corners, clearly fabric not a stack of blocks or paper. Use the reference only for the pixel-art material richness, woven-fabric treatment and warm upper-left lighting; no food, no sack, no cord, no bow. Bold readable fold shadows and restrained surface detail, crisp stepped contours, visually substantial textile. Single object centered with generous transparent padding, no text, labels, border, floor, cast shadow, scenery or UI. This is the high-resolution source artwork, not a tiny pixel grid.

Edit this exact folded wool cloth inventory artwork. Preserve the silhouette, layered folds, warm ivory wool weave, perspective, lighting, true transparent background and padding. Change ONLY the blue selvage: make it a single bold muted indigo band about THREE TIMES as wide as the current blue stripes combined, following exactly the same path along the top right edge and over the folded front edge. This blue woven band must survive downscaling as a readable color accent. No other additions, no text, no labels. High-resolution pixel art source.

Redesign this same folded ivory wool cloth with a single indigo selvage band as production Minecraft item art. Preserve subject, three-quarter view, broad top, two visible fold layers, ivory/brown/indigo palette. True transparent background, single centered object, 15% clear margin, no text or scenery. High-resolution pixel-art MASTER designed for a tiny final inventory icon, not a detailed illustration. Make only LARGE deliberate pixel clusters: ivory top as two broad tones, thick dark fold seams, broad blue band approximately one eighth of the object's width. Each important seam and band must be several percent of the silhouette width. Three light levels per material, maximum about twelve deliberate colors, hard color boundaries, no gradients, no smooth shading, no woven microtexture, no individual threads, no tiny highlights, no dithering, no noisy speckling. Communicate wool with a few large stepped edge notches rather than texture. Bold geometry and a clean readable silhouette. Do not add a pixel grid.

Edit this exact Minecraft folded ivory wool cloth item artwork. Keep silhouette, camera, two fold layers, dark seams, broad blue band, lighting and transparent background unchanged. Add readable MATERIAL TEXTURE to the empty ivory top: about 15 to 20 deliberately placed short chunky staggered diagonal weave dashes, alternating muted oatmeal shadow and cream highlight. Each dash must be a broad connected pixel cluster, about 5 to 8 percent of the cloth width, following the plane's perspective, with plenty of unmarked ivory between them. Texture contrast moderate and clearly visible, but weaker than fold seams and blue band. Also a few matching broad fiber marks on the folded edges. It should feel woven wool, not dirty, polka dots, checkerboard, or a printed decorative pattern. High-resolution pixel-art master with coarse purposeful marks that survive reduction; no individual threads, fine grain, speckling, gradients or photographic microtexture. Do not leave the center blank. Single object only, real transparent background.
